capabilities: Syncs vault files with Baidu Netdisk
Pairs devices with an encrypted pairing code
Keeps conflict copies and cleans up duplicate copies
Shows real-time sync progress on desktop and mobile
extras: Needs a one-time free Baidu developer application registration; deeper technical and crash-recovery documentation lives in a separate DEVELOPER.md; Android users install from a separate mobile zip.
motivation: Designed for users who wish to use Baidu Netdisk as their primary cloud knowledge base storage.
problem: Users who want Baidu Netdisk as their main cloud store for a vault have no native, safe way to keep notes and large attachments in sync, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: Inspired by owl234/obsidian-baidu-netdisk-sync for end-to-end encryption concepts.

summary: Syncs vault files with Baidu Netdisk, using conflict copies, optional AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption and one-click device pairing.
